description: Evidence collector/normalizer and snapshot builder (D7). Aggregates evidence from D1-D6 scanners, normalizes timestamps/hashes, builds RepositorySnapshot with all structure/runtime/blocks/composer/dependencies/tests data, computes canonical SHA-256 hash for determinism. Depends on FEAT-001 contracts, FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 scanners.
steps: Create src/evidence/collector.ts: export class EvidenceCollector { private evidence: Evidence[] = []; add(evidence: Evidence): void; addAll(evidence: Evidence[]): void; getAll(): Evidence[]; generateEvidenceId(scannerName: string, path: string): string; }. generateEvidenceId uses SHA-256(scannerName + path + timestamp).

Create src/evidence/normalizer.ts: export function normalizeEvidence(evidence: Evidence[]): Evidence[]. Sort by path, then timestamp. Deduplicate by evidenceId. Validate required fields (evidenceId, path, kind, claim).

Create src/snapshot/builder.ts: export async function buildSnapshot(repositoryRoot: string, adapter: RepositoryAdapter): Promise<RepositorySnapshot>. Steps: (1) Run all scanners D1-D6 in sequence, (2) Collect all evidence from scanner results, (3) Normalize evidence, (4) Construct RepositorySnapshot object with schemaVersion '1.0.0', repository metadata (commitSha from adapter.getGitCommit(), scanTimestamp = new Date().toISOString()), structure/runtime/blocks/composer/dependencies/tests data from scanner results, evidence array, findings array (aggregate from all scanners), (5) Compute canonicalHash = SHA-256(JSON.stringify(snapshot, excludeHashField)) where excludeHashField omits canonicalHash and timestamp fields (deterministic serialization: sort object keys, stable JSON), (6) Return snapshot with canonicalHash set.

Create src/snapshot/hasher.ts: export function computeSnapshotHash(snapshot: Omit<RepositorySnapshot, 'canonicalHash'>): string. Implements deterministic JSON serialization: remove timestamp/scanTimestamp, sort all object keys recursively, JSON.stringify, SHA-256 hash, return hex string.
Add unit tests __tests__/unit/evidence-collector.test.ts: test add/addAll/getAll, test generateEvidenceId uniqueness and determinism
Add unit tests __tests__/unit/evidence-normalizer.test.ts: test sort order (by path), test deduplication, test validation (missing required fields throws error)

Add unit tests __tests__/unit/snapshot-hasher.test.ts: test computeSnapshotHash determinism (same input -> same hash), test timestamp exclusion (changing timestamp does not change hash), test key sorting (object key order does not affect hash)

Add integration test __tests__/integration/test-snapshot-builder.ts: mock adapter, run buildSnapshot on fixture data (mock scanner results), assert snapshot.schemaVersion === '1.0.0', assert snapshot.canonicalHash is 64-char hex string, assert snapshot.evidence.length > 0
Update src/index.ts to export buildSnapshot, EvidenceCollector, normalizeEvidence, computeSnapshotHash
acceptance_criteria: EvidenceCollector aggregates evidence from multiple scanners without loss
Evidence normalizer sorts by path, deduplicates, validates required fields
buildSnapshot constructs complete RepositorySnapshot with all D1-D6 data
canonicalHash is deterministic: same repository state -> same hash
canonicalHash excludes timestamp fields (scan time variance does not affect hash)
Snapshot JSON is valid against RepositorySnapshot interface
Unit tests achieve >85% coverage for evidence and snapshot modules
verification: Run pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery test and confirm all evidence/snapshot tests pass

Create integration test __tests__/integration/test-determinism.ts: run buildSnapshot twice on same adapter (same repository state), assert snapshot1.canonicalHash === snapshot2.canonicalHash (determinism proof)
Run pnpm typecheck:all and confirm no type errors
findings: FEAT-004 completed successfully. EvidenceCollector class implements add/addAll/getAll methods for aggregating evidence from multiple scanners, and generateEvidenceId creates SHA-256 hashes from scanner name + path + timestamp. normalizeEvidence function sorts evidence by path then timestamp, deduplicates by evidenceId, and validates required fields (evidenceId, path, kind, claim). buildSnapshot function orchestrates all D1-D6 scanners in sequence, collects 171 evidence records and 6 findings, constructs RepositorySnapshot with schemaVersion 1.0.0, repository metadata (owner: onlinewebsites, name: quiz-platform, commitSha, scanTimestamp), structure data (11 apps, 18 packages, 3 services), runtime data (pnpm workspace, turbo build system, 1 framework), blocks data (18 documented families, 13 implemented blocks, 21 rendered components, 3 verified blocks, 129 discrepancies), composer data (1 service, 9 APIs, 11 schemas, 19 UI components), dependencies graph (18 nodes, 15 edges), test suites (6 unit, 0 integration, 1 E2E). computeSnapshotHash implements deterministic SHA-256 serialization by recursively removing timestamp, scanTimestamp, evidenceId, and findingId fields (which contain timestamps/randomness), then using stable key sorting to produce consistent JSON regardless of insertion order. Determinism test confirms: two snapshots of same repository state produce identical canonicalHash (e8b44110d03a6504abb2658fcd3dc1e9b6d3e46797cb51b9bbf54db60576e993) despite different scanTimestamp values, proving timestamp variance does not affect hash. All 83 unit tests pass (evidence-collector: 8 tests, evidence-normalizer: 8 tests, snapshot-hasher: 8 tests, plus existing D1-D6 tests). Integration tests verify snapshot completeness and determinism. TypeScript compilation passes. Committed to m1-repository-discovery branch.
